Luna Swarm - Modelling the 1Hive Ecosystem in cadCAD

Proposal Information

Proposal Description:
The Luna Swarm is a collaboration of individuals and organizations that seek to rigorously model the 1Hive ecosystem in cadCAD, providing tools for operational decision support with future design and governance decisions.

Proposal Details:
This post lays out a [work-in-progress] roadmap of features to build on & improve the initial cadCAD Conviction Voting model, and modeling other features, mechanisms and subsystems specific to 1Hive and the Gardens Swarm smart contract template.

Expected duration or delivery date (if applicable):
This will be an ongoing initiative, with model iterations prioritized by the 1Hive community. This initial proposal aims to fund 1-3 months of work, and subsequent proposals may request more funding to continue modeling work.

How does this help Token Engineers and benefit the Token Engineering community?
Using complex systems engineering and rigorous data science methodology, the 1Hive ecosystem can be iteratively modeled to provide Computer-Aided Governance to empower the 1Hive organization using cadCAD.

cadCAD is a complex systems design methodology, and a Python package that assists in the processes of designing, testing and validating complex systems through simulation, with support for Monte Carlo methods, A/B testing and parameter sweeps.

I would like to know exactly how this benefits the Token Engineering Community, personally I believe in the team member’s ability to do great/outstanding work and think having them on the TEC is an amazing opportunity.
In regards to communities to model 1Hive is pretty big and probably modelling it can help further modelling other communities or our own.
If you guys have meetings for discussing work, can we join as listeners only? To learn from your thought processes? Can you do it in some of the voice channels on the TEC? Can it be recorded?

Absolutely - thanks for the follow up questions Tonga!

Given that the TEC infrastructure is built off the Gardens Swarm tools & templates (Augmented Bonding Curve, Conviction Voting, etc), and 1Hive also makes use of the Gardens Swarm tools (although in slightly different context), there is a lot of overlap and similarities in the 1Hive ecosystem and the TE Commons, or other Commons that may be launched with this toolkit.

The Luna Swarm, by modelling these components in 1Hive, is aiding the TEC in the reusability of these models, given their customizable and open source nature. Much of the work we do modelling 1Hive benefits every other group using similar tools.

We invite anyone interested to join in the Luna Swarm discussions that take place on the 1Hive Discord.
Weekly calls are also open invite and listed on the cadCAD public calendar, and contributors are welcomed - internships for learning cadCAD also available, with POAP certificate on project completion.

Oh, I should also note on this proposal that this working group also received funds from the 1Hive Community and two rounds of Gitcoin Grants, and are collecting them all in a Luna DAO for compensating contributions. I will edit the proposal above accordingly.

Thanks for engaging in the discussion!
